name: Monarchy
overview: The Scripture, as described by Samuel in 1 Samuel 8:11-16, presents a sobering view of monarchy, emphasizing the burdens a king places on his people. The king will conscript sons for military service, appoint captains over large groups, and assign labor for his own benefit. He will also take daughters for domestic roles, seize the best fields and vineyards for his servants, and claim a tenth of the produce and servants to serve his administration. This depiction reveals the heavy demands and loss of personal freedom that come with human kingship, highlighting the need for Christ-centered trust rather than reliance on earthly rulers.
